disclosures.text: A hand tool machine includes a clamping flange.
An auxiliary handle is attachable to the clamping flange.
The auxiliary handle's head part is fixable, oriented to the working axis.
A loop-shaped clamping band is guided within the head part.
The clamping band is manually tensionable via a tensioning means.
The clamping band has at least one radially inwardly projecting cam.
The cam positively engages a corresponding recess of the clamping flange.

A hand tool machine comprising a clamping flange, an attachable auxiliary handle with a head part fixable oriented to a working axis, a loop-shaped clamping band guided within the head part and manually tensionable via a tensioning means, w
Multiple cams are offset along the loop of the clamping band.
At least two different types of cams are present.
The clamping band is made of metal.
The tensioning means is a rotatable handle part.
The rotatable handle part tensions the clamping band via a clamping screw.
The clamping band has a drive opening at each of its two ends.
The drive opening positively encloses a head of the clamping screw.
The clamping band has a radially outwardly projecting guide lug at each of its two ends.
The head part forms two guide surfaces.
The ends of the clamping band are guidable on the guide surfaces.
